station_selection.rule: nearest supported existing route vertex to each fixed arc target, max arc offset spacing/2, deterministic lower-index tie; initial and explicit closure always retained
station_selection.radial_margin_reason: covers 0.075m arrival error plus 0.025m additional margin; full-turn swept robot envelope included

station_turn_protocol.overscan_tail_role: auxiliary retained raw frames, never stretched into second complete gyro turn

geometry.cache_validation: exact source-file hashes, all geometric settings, and ordered input-point bytes
geometry.method: actual static collision support and conservative full-turn swept-volume clearance
geometry.scope: horizontal stationary placements; unsupported, stepped, sloped, and obstructed poses rejected
geometry.yaw_filter: none; conservative swept volume permits every yaw and a full turn

estimate.time_allowance_rule: 1.35x ideal translational transit + ideal turn/settle/post-stop +1.2sec turn overhead per visit +60sec startup/export allowance

scope: new source-mapping capture protocol only, not new relocalization validation points; controller GT may navigate simulator but must never enter estimation
